latency_quantiles: median averages the center pair; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n); max includes every sample
scope: Normalized synthetic random vectors and exact self-match checks, plus optional non-self Recall@10 against exhaustive float32 ground truth. Timings include the selected SQLite search path and live validation/reranking but exclude embedding inference and index preparation. These are warm trials after ingestion/preparation; first_query_ms is not a controlled cold-cache test. Not natural-language relevance, isolated GPU execution, power or competitor measurement. Retained archives are explicit benchmark-only directories and can be reused to investigate cold starts separately.
